# Glitter

Scatters tiny tilted flakes over surfaces that catch the light one by one, so they twinkle as the light sweeps or the pointer moves. Give it a selection mask to glitter one object.

<EffectDemo effect="glitter" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { glitter } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/glitter';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
const hero = scene.getObjectByName('hero'); // the objects to select
composer.add(glitter({ mask: { selection: [hero] } }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.density = 0.35`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                                                      | Default     | Range     | Description                                                       |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `density`       | number                                                    | `0.35`      | 0 – 1     | Fraction of the surface covered in flakes.                        |
| `size`          | number                                                    | `4`         | 2 – 16 px | Size of a flake on screen.                                        |
| `intensity`     | number                                                    | `4`         | 0 – 16    | Brightness of a flake that catches the light (HDR, so it blooms). |
| `color`         | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#fff4d6'` |           | Flake color.                                                      |
| `rainbow`       | number                                                    | `0.4`       | 0 – 1     | Mix toward a different hue per flake.                             |
| `speed`         | number                                                    | `0.5`       | 0 – 2     | How fast the light sweeps around (slow enough not to flicker).    |
| `followPointer` | number                                                    | `0`         | 0 – 1     | How much the light follows the pointer instead of sweeping.       |
| `seed`          | integer                                                   | `0`         | 0 – 99    | Picks a different scatter of flakes.                              |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset        | Settings                         |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `gold`        | `color: '#ffcf5a'`, `rainbow: 0` |
| `holo`        | `rainbow: 1`, `density: 0.5`     |
| `fine`        | `size: 2.5`, `density: 0.6`      |
| `interactive` | `followPointer: 1`, `speed: 0`   |

Apply one with `glitter({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Geometry buffers:** reads normals, which the composer renders only while an effect needs them.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Cost:** 8.3 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/glitter`, including the shared effect runtime.
